title: Netflix's 'Rabbit, Rabbit' Adds 'Sing Sing' Star Clarence Maclin To Adam Driver, Regina Hall And Will Poutler Series - Blavity
text:
Sing Sing breakout Clarence Maclin is the latest to be added to the Netflix thriller series Rabbit Rabbit alongside Adam Driver and Regina Hall.
Will Poutler and Odessa Young will also star in the series.
As Variety reported, Maclin’s role is a recurring guest star role, but everything else about the character and role are behing held tight to the chest.
GO TO PAGE
What’s the plot of ‘Rabbit, Rabbit’?
Here’s the logline: When an escaped convict is cornered by law enforcement at a truck stop, he takes hostages in an effort to bargain for his freedom. But the standoff soon escalates into an unmanageable social experiment with his captives, as well as an emotional poker match with a veteran FBI Crisis Negotiator trained in “tactical empathy.”
Maclin co-starred in Sing Sing with Colman Domingo and plays himself in the film, which was inspired in part by his incarceration story. He received a story by credit on the film, and was nominated for an Oscar for Best Adapted Screenplay. He also received several nominations for Best Supporting Actor, including a nomination from BAFTA. His next role will be in the film In Starland.
Th showrunner for Rabbit, Rabbit is Peter Craig, who also is the writer, creator and executive producer. Phillip Barantini is directing and also executive produces. Other executive producers are Driver, Samantha Beddoe for her and Barantini’s It’s All Made Up Productions and Bryan Unkeless for his and Craig’s Night Owl banner. The series falls under Craig’s first-look deal at MRC.
